name: Dirona

attributes.attribute: a Continental Celtic healing goddess whose name means star
often connected with the Celtic Apollo but also stood alone
depicted with serpents and eggs, symbols of rebirth and fertility

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: The Continental Celtic goddess Sirona, also recorded as Dirona and possibly Tsirona, drew many inscriptions in France and other continental lands. Her name translates as star. Inscriptions invoked her as a healing goddess. Romans often paired her with the Celtic Apollo, but she also stood alone. Artists showed her with serpents and eggs. Those images link her to rebirth and to fertility.

okr.objective: Document the healing goddess Sirona and her Dirona spelling.
